title: Resend
description: Developer-tool noir: a pure black page, near-white ink with cool grey body copy, cool-white 19% hairlines, black cards lit by soft grey glows, one lilac-violet accent. A high-contrast display serif for the big titles, a light grotesk for section titles, Inter body and a neutral mono for code.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling (white page, graphite ink, a deeper violet)
sets a theme-only --resend-serif (Newsreader) that the resend hero and closing titles read; other themes fall back to their display face
Newsreader stands in for Domaine Display (closed), Instrument Sans for ABC Favorit (closed); Inter and Commit Mono are the original's own open faces
name: resend-theme
